<!--
Design
  6 samples = 2 cell lines (LS1, ASC) x 3 time points (Day0, Day1, Day3); Day2 excluded.
  - QC and doublets per sample, with QC thresholds per cell line.
  - Two views of the data:
      A. merged, no correction  -> how different are the cell lines?
      B. Harmony integration across CELL LINE only (never across time point)
         -> shared states, so the two lines can be compared state by state.
  - Shared clusters, markers (conserved + line-specific), within-line DE over time,
    comparison of the differentiation response between lines.
  - Shared pseudotime: does each line progress equally far?
  - Differentiating subset (re-integrated).
  - RNA velocity separately per cell line, shown on the shared UMAP.

Packages: Seurat (v5), harmony, scDblFinder, SingleCellExperiment, monocle3,
  ggrepel, dplyr, ggplot2, metap (for FindConservedMarkers),
  velociraptor + LoomExperiment (velocity, optional)
  install.packages(c("harmony", "ggrepel", "metap"))
  BiocManager::install(c("scDblFinder", "velociraptor", "LoomExperiment"))
  remotes::install_github("cole-trapnell-lab/monocle3")
  Download and run the JAGS macOS installer (.pkg) from SourceForge: https://sourceforge.net/projects/mcmc-jags/files/JAGS/
  install.packages("rjags") for inferCNV
-->

# Settings

```{r settings}
root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir("LPS_ASC_diff"))
rna_dir  <- file.path(root_dir, "LPS_ASC_diff", "scRNAseq")
plot_dir <- file.path(rna_dir, "Plot_combined")
res_dir  <- file.path(rna_dir, "Results_combined")
vel_plot_dir <- file.path(plot_dir, "velocity")
vel_res_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "velocity")
for (d in c(plot_dir, res_dir, vel_plot_dir, vel_res_dir)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tp_order   <- c("Day0", "Day1", "Day3")      # Day2 excluded
line_order <- c("ASC", "LS1")                # first = reference line for comparisons

samples <- expand.grid(timepoint = tp_order, cell_line = line_order, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
samples$sample <- paste0(samples$cell_line, "_", samples$timepoint)   # e.g. LS1_Day0, ASC_Day3
samples$dir    <- file.path(rna_dir, samples$sample)
samples$h5     <- file.path(samples$dir, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
samples$loom   <- file.path(samples$dir, "velocyto", paste0(samples$sample, ".loom"))
samples
stopifnot(all(file.exists(samples$h5)))

# QC thresholds per cell line. Both lines have very similar QC, so they share
# one set; 2500 genes sits in the dip that separates the low-quality cells.
qc_thr <- list(LS1 = c(min_feature = 2500, min_count = 5000, max_mt = 10),
               ASC = c(min_feature = 2500, min_count = 5000, max_mt = 10))

n_pcs <- 30
cluster_resolution <- 0.4
# Cell lines cycle; CC.Difference removes S vs G2M but keeps cycling vs non-cycling
regress_vars <- c("percent.mt", "CC.Difference")
run_velocity <- TRUE

# Known genes to follow (fill in: undifferentiated + differentiation markers)
check_genes <- c()
```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
composition_table <- function(obj, cluster_col, group_col = "timepoint") {
  prop.table(table(cluster = obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]],
                   group = obj@meta.data[[group_col]]), margin = 1)
}

plot_composition <- function(obj, cluster_col, group_col, file) {
  df <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]],
                            group = obj@meta.data[[group_col]]))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(cluster, Freq, fill = group)) + geom_col(position = "fill") +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Fraction of cells", fill = group_col) + theme_classic()
  ggsave(file, p, width = 8, height = 4)
  p
}

pick_root_cluster <- function(obj, cluster_col, root_tp = "Day0", min_cells = 50) {
  prop <- composition_table(obj, cluster_col)
  n  <- table(obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]])
  ok <- names(n)[n >= min_cells]
  ok[which.max(prop[ok, root_tp])]
}

pick_diff_clusters <- function(obj, cluster_col, root_tp = "Day0", max_root_frac = 0.5) {
  prop <- composition_table(obj, cluster_col)
  unique(c(pick_root_cluster(obj, cluster_col, root_tp),
           rownames(prop)[prop[, root_tp] < max_root_frac]))
}

# Monocle3 on an existing UMAP (no SeuratWrappers needed)
run_monocle3 <- function(obj, cluster_col, out_col, reduction = "umap", root_tp = "Day0") {
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
  cds <- monocle3::new_cell_data_set(
    expression_data = counts,
    cell_metadata   = obj@meta.data[colnames(counts), , drop = FALSE],
    gene_metadata   = data.frame(gene_short_name = rownames(counts), row.names = rownames(counts)))
  SingleCellExperiment::reducedDim(cds, "UMAP") <- Embeddings(obj, reduction)[colnames(cds), ]
  cds <- monocle3::cluster_cells(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP")
  cds <- monocle3::learn_graph(cds, use_partition = FALSE)
  root_cl <- pick_root_cluster(obj, cluster_col, root_tp)
  root_cells <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[cluster_col]] == root_cl & obj$timepoint == root_tp]
  message("Monocle3 root: cluster ", root_cl, " (", length(root_cells), " cells)")
  cds <- monocle3::order_cells(cds, root_cells = root_cells)
  pt <- monocle3::pseudotime(cds)[colnames(obj)]
  pt[is.infinite(pt)] <- NA
  obj[[out_col]] <- pt
  list(obj = obj, cds = cds)
}

# Harmony integration across cell lines on a (sub)set of cells
integrate_by_line <- function(obj) {
  obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
  obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$cell_line)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = 2000)      # per line, then combined ranking
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, vars.to.regress = regress_vars)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- IntegrateLayers(obj, method = HarmonyIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca",
                         new.reduction = "harmony", verbose = FALSE)
  obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
  obj
}

# --- velocity helpers ---
# velocyto barcode "LS1_Day0:AAACCTGAGAAGGCCTx" -> Seurat "LS1_Day0_AAACCTGAGAAGGCCT-1"
read_loom <- function(path, prefix) {
  le <- LoomExperiment::import(path, type = "SingleCellLoomExperiment")
  bc <- sub("x$", "", sub(".*:", "", colData(le)$CellID))
  cn <- paste0(prefix, "_", bc, "-1")
  rn <- make.unique(as.character(rowData(le)$Gene))
  get <- function(a) { m <- as(assay(le, a), "dgCMatrix"); dimnames(m) <- list(rn, cn); m }
  list(spliced = get("spliced"), unspliced = get("unspliced"))
}

load_looms <- function(files) {        # named vector: sample -> loom path
  parts <- lapply(names(files), function(s) read_loom(files[[s]], s))
  genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(parts, function(x) rownames(x$spliced)))
  list(spliced   = do.call(cbind, lapply(parts, function(x) x$spliced[genes, ])),
       unspliced = do.call(cbind, lapply(parts, function(x) x$unspliced[genes, ])))
}

run_velocity_line <- function(obj, loom, cluster_col, tag, dimred = "harmony") {
  cells <- intersect(colnames(obj), colnames(loom$spliced))
  message("[velocity ", tag, "] matched ", length(cells), " / ", ncol(obj), " cells")
  if (length(cells) < 0.5 * ncol(obj)) stop("Barcode mismatch between Seurat and loom")
  genes <- intersect(rownames(obj), rownames(loom$spliced))
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays = list(counts    = GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[genes, cells],
                  spliced   = loom$spliced[genes, cells],
                  unspliced = loom$unspliced[genes, cells]),
    colData = obj@meta.data[cells, ])
  reducedDim(sce, "PCA")  <- Embeddings(obj, dimred)[cells, 1:n_pcs]
  reducedDim(sce, "UMAP") <- Embeddings(obj, "umap")[cells, ]
  velo <- velociraptor::scvelo(sce, assay.X = "counts",
                               subset.row = intersect(VariableFeatures(obj), genes),
                               use.dimred = "PCA", mode = "dynamical")
  cd <- colData(velo)
  out <- data.frame(row.names = cells,
                    rna_latent_time = if ("latent_time" %in% colnames(cd)) cd$latent_time else NA,
                    rna_velocity_pseudotime = cd$velocity_pseudotime)
  emb <- velociraptor::embedVelocity(reducedDim(sce, "UMAP"), velo)[, 1:2]
  for (key in c(cluster_col, "timepoint")) {
    p <- velociraptor::plotVelocityStream(sce, emb, use.dimred = "UMAP", color_by = key) +
      ggtitle(paste("RNA velocity -", tag, "-", key))
    ggsave(file.path(vel_plot_dir, paste0("stream_", tag, "_", key, ".pdf")), p, width = 7, height = 6)
  }
  if ("fit_likelihood" %in% colnames(rowData(velo))) {
    drivers <- data.frame(gene = rownames(velo), fit_likelihood = rowData(velo)$fit_likelihood) %>%
      filter(!is.na(fit_likelihood)) %>% arrange(desc(fit_likelihood))
    write.csv(drivers, file.path(vel_res_dir, paste0("driver_genes_", tag, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  out
}

```

# 1. Read, QC, doublets
```{r read-qc}
rna_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
  x <- Read10X_h5(samples$h5[i])
  if (is.list(x)) x <- x[["Gene Expression"]]
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = x, project = samples$sample[i], min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
  obj$sample    <- samples$sample[i]
  obj$cell_line <- samples$cell_line[i]
  obj$timepoint <- samples$timepoint[i]
  obj$percent.mt   <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^MT-")
  obj$percent.ribo <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^RP[SL]")
  obj
})
rna <- merge(rna_list[[1]], y = rna_list[-1], add.cell.ids = samples$sample)
rna <- JoinLayers(rna)
rm(rna_list); invisible(gc())

rna$sample    <- factor(rna$sample, levels = samples$sample)
rna$cell_line <- factor(rna$cell_line, levels = line_order)
rna$timepoint <- factor(rna$timepoint, levels = tp_order)

p <- VlnPlot(rna, c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
             group.by = "sample", pt.size = 0, ncol = 4, log = FALSE) & RotatedAxis()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "01_QC_violin.pdf"), p, width = 16, height = 5)
p

# Per-cell-line thresholds
thr <- do.call(rbind, qc_thr)[as.character(rna$cell_line), ]
keep <- rna$nFeature_RNA > thr[, "min_feature"] & rna$nCount_RNA > thr[, "min_count"] &
        rna$percent.mt < thr[, "max_mt"]
print(table(rna$sample, keep))
rna <- subset(rna, cells = colnames(rna)[keep])

dbl <- scDblFinder(GetAssayData(rna, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts"), samples = rna$sample)
rna$doublet_class <- dbl$scDblFinder.class
rna$doublet_score <- dbl$scDblFinder.score
print(table(rna$sample, rna$doublet_class))
rna <- subset(rna, doublet_class == "singlet")
```

```{r normalise}
rna <- NormalizeData(rna)
rna <- CellCycleScoring(rna, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes,
                        g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes)
rna$CC.Difference <- rna$S.Score - rna$G2M.Score

# A. No correction: how different are the lines?
rna <- FindVariableFeatures(rna, nfeatures = 2000)
rna <- ScaleData(rna, vars.to.regress = regress_vars)
rna <- RunPCA(rna, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
```

## Sample check (6 samples)
Within each line the order should be Day0 → Day1 → Day3.
```{r sample-check}
pb_counts <- AggregateExpression(rna, group.by = "sample", assays = "RNA")$RNA
colnames(pb_counts) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(pb_counts))     # Seurat turns "_" into "-"
pb_counts <- pb_counts[, samples$sample]
pb_log2 <- log2(t(t(pb_counts) / colSums(pb_counts)) * 1e6 + 1)
hv <- intersect(VariableFeatures(rna), rownames(pb_log2))

cor_mat <- cor(as.matrix(pb_log2[hv, ]))
write.csv(cor_mat, file.path(res_dir, "sample_pseudobulk_correlation.csv"))
p1 <- ggplot(as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)), aes(Var1, Var2, fill = Freq)) + geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Freq)), size = 3) + scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "r") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal() + RotatedAxis()

pca_pb <- prcomp(t(as.matrix(pb_log2[hv, ])), scale. = TRUE)
pc_df  <- cbind(as.data.frame(pca_pb$x[, 1:2]), samples)
p2 <- ggplot(pc_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = cell_line, label = timepoint)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = cell_line), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_text_repel() + theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "02_sample_correlation.pdf"), p1, width = 6, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "02_sample_pseudobulk_PCA.pdf"), p2, width = 6, height = 5)
p1 + p2

qc_by_sample <- rna@meta.data %>% group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), median_nCount = median(nCount_RNA), median_nFeature = median(nFeature_RNA),
            median_pct_mt = median(percent.mt), pct_G1 = round(100 * mean(Phase == "G1"), 1))
write.csv(qc_by_sample, file.path(res_dir, "qc_by_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
knitr::kable(qc_by_sample)
```

# 3. Integration across cell lines (Harmony)
Only cell line is corrected. Time point is left alone because it is the biology.
```{r integrate}
rna <- integrate_by_line(rna)
rna <- FindNeighbors(rna, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:n_pcs)
for (r in c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)) rna <- FindClusters(rna, resolution = r, verbose = FALSE)
rna$rna_clusters <- rna@meta.data[[paste0("RNA_snn_res.", cluster_resolution)]]
Idents(rna) <- "rna_clusters"
rna <- RunUMAP(rna, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction.name = "umap", verbose = FALSE)

p <- DimPlot(rna, group.by = c("rna_clusters", "cell_line", "timepoint", "Phase"), label = TRUE, ncol = 4)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "03_UMAP_integrated.pdf"), p, width = 22, height = 5)
p
p <- DimPlot(rna, group.by = "timepoint", split.by = "cell_line", ncol = 2)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "03_UMAP_integrated_split_by_line.pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 5)
p

# Which states are shared and which are line-specific?
rna$group <- factor(paste(rna$cell_line, rna$timepoint, sep = "_"), levels = samples$sample)
p1 <- plot_composition(rna, "rna_clusters", "cell_line", file.path(plot_dir, "03_cluster_by_line.pdf"))
p2 <- plot_composition(rna, "rna_clusters", "group",     file.path(plot_dir, "03_cluster_by_sample.pdf"))
p1 + p2
write.csv(as.data.frame.matrix(table(rna$rna_clusters, rna$group)),
          file.path(res_dir, "cluster_counts_by_sample.csv"))
```

```{r markers}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(rna, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
write.csv(markers, file.path(res_dir, "markers_clusters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
top5 <- markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 5)
p <- DotPlot(rna, features = unique(top5$gene)) + RotatedAxis()

# Markers shared by both lines within each cluster (needs cells from both lines)
if (requireNamespace("metap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  both <- names(which(apply(table(rna$rna_clusters, rna$cell_line) >= 20, 1, all)))
  cons <- bind_rows(lapply(both, function(cl) {
    FindConservedMarkers(rna, ident.1 = cl, grouping.var = "cell_line", only.pos = TRUE,
                         min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE) %>%

if (length(intersect(check_genes, rownames(rna))) > 0) {
  p <- DotPlot(rna, features = intersect(check_genes, rownames(rna)), group.by = "group") + RotatedAxis()
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "04_known_markers_by_sample.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 4)

}
```

# 5. Differentiation response: DEGs between days within each line
```{r de-time}
# (a) Within-line DE over time (cell-level Wilcoxon; one sample per condition,
#     so treat p-values as a ranking)
Idents(rna) <- "group"
cmp <- expand.grid(line = line_order, pair = c("Day1_vs_Day0", "Day3_vs_Day0", "Day3_vs_Day1"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
de_time <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(cmp)), function(i) {
  tp <- strsplit(cmp$pair[i], "_vs_")[[1]]
  FindMarkers(rna, ident.1 = paste(cmp$line[i], tp[1], sep = "_"),
              ident.2 = paste(cmp$line[i], tp[2], sep = "_"), logfc.threshold = 0.25) %>%
    mutate(gene = rownames(.), cell_line = cmp$line[i], comparison = cmp$pair[i])
}))
Idents(rna) <- "rna_clusters"

# (b) DEG plots per line: Day1 vs Day0, Day3 vs Day0, Day3 vs Day1
deg_padj <- 0.05      # adjusted p-value cutoff
deg_lfc  <- 0.5       # |log2 fold change| cutoff
n_label  <- 10        # genes labelled per direction in each volcano

de_time <- de_time %>%
  mutate(comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Day1_vs_Day0", "Day3_vs_Day0", "Day3_vs_Day1")),
         cell_line  = factor(cell_line, levels = line_order),
         direction  = case_when(p_val_adj < deg_padj & avg_log2FC >  deg_lfc ~ "up",
                                p_val_adj < deg_padj & avg_log2FC < -deg_lfc ~ "down",
                                TRUE ~ "ns"),
         neg_log10_padj = pmin(-log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300), 300))
write.csv(de_time, file.path(res_dir, "DE_time_within_line.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Number of DEGs per comparison
deg_n <- de_time %>% filter(direction != "ns") %>% count(cell_line, comparison, direction)
p <- ggplot(deg_n, aes(comparison, ifelse(direction == "up", n, -n), fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n, vjust = ifelse(direction == "up", -0.3, 1.2)), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_line) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of DEGs (down < 0 < up)", fill = NULL,
       subtitle = sprintf("padj < %s, |log2FC| > %s", deg_padj, deg_lfc)) +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05_DEG_counts.pdf"), p, width = 9, height = 4.5)
p

# Volcano plots: rows = cell line, columns = comparison
lab <- de_time %>% filter(direction != "ns") %>%
  group_by(cell_line, comparison, direction) %>% slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = n_label)
p <- ggplot(de_time, aes(avg_log2FC, neg_log10_padj, colour = direction)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-deg_lfc, deg_lfc), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(deg_padj), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene), size = 2.3, max.overlaps = Inf,
                  min.segment.length = 0, segment.size = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(cell_line ~ comparison) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(up = "#B2182B", down = "#2166AC", ns = "grey75")) +
  labs(x = "log2 fold change", y = "-log10 adjusted p", colour = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), strip.background = element_blank(),
                     strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05_DEG_volcano.pdf"), p, width = 14, height = 9)
p

# Heatmap per line: top DEGs from all three comparisons, mean expression per day
# (z-score across Day0/Day1/Day3), genes grouped by the day they peak
for (ln in line_order) {
  top <- de_time %>% filter(cell_line == ln, direction != "ns") %>%
    group_by(comparison, direction) %>% slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 15) %>% pull(gene) %>% unique()
  if (length(top) < 2) next
  cols <- paste0(ln, "_", tp_order)
  m <- pb_log2[intersect(top, rownames(pb_log2)), cols, drop = FALSE]
  m <- t(scale(t(m))); m[is.na(m)] <- 0
  colnames(m) <- tp_order
  peak <- factor(tp_order[apply(m, 1, which.max)], levels = tp_order)
  ord <- order(peak, -apply(m, 1, max))
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(m[ord, , drop = FALSE])); colnames(df) <- c("gene", "day", "z")
  df$gene <- factor(df$gene, levels = rev(rownames(m)[ord]))
  df$peak <- paste("highest at", peak[match(df$gene, rownames(m))])
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(day, gene, fill = z)) + geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(peak ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", name = "z-score") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste(ln, "- top DEGs across days")) + theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("05_DEG_heatmap_", ln, ".pdf")), p,
         width = 4.5, height = 2 + 0.12 * nrow(m), limitsize = FALSE)
  print(p)
}
```

# 5b. Markers for each day of differentiation

Three questions:
(a) Which genes mark each day (that day vs the other days), in each line?
(b) Which day markers are shared by both lines?
(c) Which cell states (clusters) are present on each day, and what marks them?

Each day is a single sample, so day markers can also carry sample-level technical
differences. Markers found in both lines (b) are the most trustworthy.

```{r day-markers, fig.height = 6}
# (a) Day markers within each line
day_markers <- bind_rows(lapply(line_order, function(ln) {
  obj <- subset(rna, cells = colnames(rna)[rna$cell_line == ln])
  Idents(obj) <- "timepoint"
  FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE) %>%
    rename(timepoint = cluster) %>% mutate(cell_line = ln)
}))
write.csv(day_markers, file.path(res_dir, "markers_day_within_line.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
day_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 1) %>% count(cell_line, timepoint) %>% knitr::kable()

# (b) Day markers conserved in both lines
if (requireNamespace("metap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  Idents(rna) <- "timepoint"
  day_cons <- bind_rows(lapply(tp_order, function(tp) {
    FindConservedMarkers(rna, ident.1 = tp, grouping.var = "cell_line", only.pos = TRUE,
                         min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(gene = rownames(.), timepoint = tp)
  }))
  Idents(rna) <- "rna_clusters"
  fc_cols <- paste0(line_order, "_avg_log2FC")
  day_cons$mean_log2FC <- rowMeans(day_cons[, fc_cols])
  day_cons <- day_cons %>% arrange(timepoint, desc(mean_log2FC))
  write.csv(day_cons, file.path(res_dir, "markers_day_conserved_across_lines.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

# Top markers per day (per line), shown on all 6 samples
top_day <- day_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, timepoint) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 8) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(timepoint) %>% distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
p <- DotPlot(rna, features = unique(top_day$gene), group.by = "group") + RotatedAxis()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05b_day_markers_dotplot.pdf"), p, width = 4 + 0.25 * nrow(top_day), height = 4)
p

# Pseudobulk heatmap of the same genes (z-score across the 6 samples)
hm <- pb_log2[intersect(top_day$gene, rownames(pb_log2)), samples$sample, drop = FALSE]
hm <- t(scale(t(hm))); hm[is.na(hm)] <- 0
hm_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(hm)); colnames(hm_df) <- c("gene", "sample", "z")
hm_df$gene <- factor(hm_df$gene, levels = rev(rownames(hm)))
hm_df$day_marker_of <- top_day$timepoint[match(hm_df$gene, top_day$gene)]
p <- ggplot(hm_df, aes(sample, gene, fill = z)) + geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(day_marker_of ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", name = "z-score") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal() + RotatedAxis() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05b_day_markers_pseudobulk_heatmap.pdf"), p,
       width = 6, height = 2 + 0.12 * nrow(hm), limitsize = FALSE)
p

# (c) Cell states on each day: composition and cluster markers within each day
comp <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = rna$rna_clusters, group = rna$group))
p1 <- ggplot(comp, aes(group, Freq, fill = cluster)) + geom_col(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of cells", fill = "Cluster") + theme_classic() + RotatedAxis()
p2 <- DimPlot(rna, group.by = "rna_clusters", split.by = "timepoint", label = TRUE) + NoLegend()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05b_clusters_per_day_composition.pdf"), p1, width = 6, height = 4.5)
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "05b_clusters_split_by_day_UMAP.pdf"), p2, width = 15, height = 5)
p1
p2

min_cells_cluster <- 30
cl_by_day <- bind_rows(lapply(tp_order, function(tp) {
  obj <- subset(rna, cells = colnames(rna)[rna$timepoint == tp])
  big <- names(which(table(obj$rna_clusters) >= min_cells_cluster))
  if (length(big) < 2) return(NULL)
  obj <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$rna_clusters %in% big])
  obj$cl_day <- droplevels(factor(obj$rna_clusters))
  Idents(obj) <- "cl_day"
  FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(timepoint = tp)
}))
write.csv(cl_by_day, file.path(res_dir, "markers_clusters_within_each_day.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

pdf(file.path(plot_dir, "05b_cluster_markers_within_each_day.pdf"), width = 16, height = 5)
for (tp in unique(cl_by_day$timepoint)) {
  top <- cl_by_day %>% filter(timepoint == tp, p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 5)
  obj <- subset(rna, cells = colnames(rna)[rna$timepoint == tp &
                                             rna$rna_clusters %in% unique(top$cluster)])
  print(DotPlot(obj, features = unique(top$gene), group.by = "rna_clusters") +
          RotatedAxis() + ggtitle(paste("Cluster markers within", tp)))
}
dev.off()
```

# 6. Trajectory per cell line

Each line is re-processed on its own (its own variable genes, PCA, UMAP and clusters,
no integration) and its trajectory is rooted at that line's own Day0 cells. Nothing
forces the two lines onto a common path: the integrated UMAP aligns the lines by
construction, so a shared starting point there is partly an effect of Harmony.
`rna_pseudotime` is therefore only comparable within a line.

```{r trajectory-per-line, fig.height = 5}
process_line <- function(obj) {
  obj[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(obj[["RNA"]])
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, vars.to.regress = regress_vars, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, npcs = 50, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:n_pcs, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = cluster_resolution, verbose = FALSE)
  obj$line_clusters <- obj$seurat_clusters
  Idents(obj) <- "line_clusters"
  RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction.name = "umap", verbose = FALSE)
}

# Genes x pseudotime-bin heatmap (z-scored), genes ordered by where they peak
plot_pseudotime_heatmap <- function(obj, genes, time_col, title, n_bins = 50) {
  t  <- obj@meta.data[[time_col]]; ok <- !is.na(t)
  ex <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[genes, ok, drop = FALSE])
  bins <- cut(rank(t[ok], ties.method = "first"), n_bins, labels = FALSE)
  m <- vapply(seq_len(n_bins), function(b) rowMeans(ex[, bins == b, drop = FALSE]), numeric(length(genes)))
  m <- matrix(m, nrow = length(genes), dimnames = list(genes, seq_len(n_bins)))
  m <- t(scale(t(m))); m[is.na(m)] <- 0
  m <- m[order(apply(m, 1, which.max)), , drop = FALSE]
  df <- as.data.frame(as.table(m)); colnames(df) <- c("gene", "bin", "z")
  df$gene <- factor(df$gene, levels = rev(rownames(m)))
  ggplot(df, aes(as.numeric(bin), gene, fill = z)) + geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", name = "z-score") +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime (binned)", y = NULL, title = title) + theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
}

rna_lines <- list(); cds_lines <- list()
rna$rna_pseudotime <- NA_real_
rna$line_clusters  <- NA_character_

for (ln in line_order) {
  obj <- process_line(subset(rna, cells = colnames(rna)[rna$cell_line == ln]))
  mon <- run_monocle3(obj, cluster_col = "line_clusters", out_col = "rna_pseudotime")
  obj <- mon$obj

  p1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = c("line_clusters", "timepoint", "Phase"), label = TRUE, ncol = 3)
  p2 <- monocle3::plot_cells(mon$cds, color_cells_by = "pseudotime", label_branch_points = TRUE,
                             label_roots = TRUE, label_leaves = TRUE) + ggtitle(paste(ln, "trajectory"))
  p3 <- ggplot(obj@meta.data, aes(timepoint, rna_pseudotime, fill = timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_classic() + NoLegend() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Pseudotime", title = ln)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("06_", ln, "_UMAP.pdf")), p1, width = 18, height = 5)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("06_", ln, "_trajectory.pdf")), p2 + p3, width = 12, height = 5)
  print(p1); print(p2 + p3)
  plot_composition(obj, "line_clusters", "timepoint", file.path(plot_dir, paste0("06_", ln, "_cluster_by_day.pdf")))

  markers_ln <- FindAllMarkers(obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE)
  write.csv(markers_ln, file.path(res_dir, paste0("markers_", ln, "_line_clusters.csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  # Genes that change along this line's trajectory (tested on the line's variable genes)
  pt_genes <- monocle3::graph_test(mon$cds[VariableFeatures(obj), ], neighbor_graph = "principal_graph", cores = 4)
  pt_genes <- pt_genes[order(pt_genes$q_value, -pt_genes$morans_I), ]
  write.csv(pt_genes, file.path(res_dir, paste0("pseudotime_genes_", ln, ".csv")))
  sig <- rownames(subset(pt_genes, q_value < 0.05))
  if (length(sig) >= 2) {
    p <- plot_pseudotime_heatmap(obj, head(sig, 60), "rna_pseudotime", paste(ln, "- top pseudotime genes"))
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("06_", ln, "_pseudotime_heatmap.pdf")), p, width = 7, height = 8)
    print(p)
    p <- monocle3::plot_genes_in_pseudotime(mon$cds[head(sig, 8), ], color_cells_by = "timepoint", ncol = 2)
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("06_", ln, "_genes_in_pseudotime.pdf")), p, width = 9, height = 10)
  }

  # Copy back to the combined object
  rna$rna_pseudotime[match(colnames(obj), colnames(rna))] <- obj$rna_pseudotime
  rna$line_clusters[match(colnames(obj), colnames(rna))]  <- paste0(ln, "_c", obj$line_clusters)
  rna_lines[[ln]] <- obj; cds_lines[[ln]] <- mon$cds
}

rna@meta.data %>% group_by(cell_line, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(median_pseudotime = median(rna_pseudotime, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable()

# Do the two lines start from a similar state? Pseudobulk correlation of the Day0
# samples (variable genes; no integration involved)
round(cor_mat[paste0(line_order, "_Day0"), ], 3)
```


# 7. Differentiating subset (re-integrated)
```{r diff-subset}
diff_clusters <- pick_diff_clusters(rna, "rna_clusters")
message("Differentiating subset uses clusters: ", paste(diff_clusters, collapse = ", "))
# Override after looking at 03_cluster_by_sample.pdf, e.g. diff_clusters <- c("0", "2", "5")

rna_diff <- integrate_by_line(rna_diff)
rna_diff <- FindNeighbors(rna_diff, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:n_pcs)
rna_diff <- FindClusters(rna_diff, resolution = cluster_resolution, verbose = FALSE)
rna_diff$sub_clusters <- rna_diff$seurat_clusters
Idents(rna_diff) <- "sub_clusters"
rna_diff <- RunUMAP(rna_diff, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:n_pcs, reduction.name = "umap", verbose = FALSE)

p <- DimPlot(rna_diff, group.by = c("sub_clusters", "cell_line", "timepoint"), label = TRUE, ncol = 3)

write.csv(markers_diff, file.path(res_dir, "markers_diff_subclusters.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

mon_d <- run_monocle3(rna_diff, cluster_col = "sub_clusters", out_col = "rna_pseudotime")
rna_diff <- mon_d$obj
p <- ggplot(rna_diff@meta.data, aes(timepoint, rna_pseudotime, fill = cell_line)) +

write.csv(pt_genes, file.path(res_dir, "diff_pseudotime_genes.csv"))
```

# 8. RNA velocity per cell line
Fitted separately for each line (kinetics differ between lines) and drawn on the shared UMAP.
Latent time is only comparable within a line.

```{r velocity}
vel_ok <- run_velocity &&
  all(vapply(c("velociraptor", "LoomExperiment"), requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)) &&
  all(file.exists(samples$loom))
if (!vel_ok) message("Velocity skipped (packages or loom files missing)")

if (vel_ok) {
  for (ln in line_order) {
    s_ln <- samples[samples$cell_line == ln, ]
    loom <- load_looms(setNames(s_ln$loom, s_ln$sample))
    for (obj_name in c("rna", "rna_diff")) {
      obj <- get(obj_name)
      sub <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$cell_line == ln])
      cl  <- if (obj_name == "rna") "rna_clusters" else "sub_clusters"
      res <- tryCatch(run_velocity_line(sub, loom, cl, paste0(ln, "_", obj_name)),
                      error = function(e) { warning(ln, " ", obj_name, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
      if (!is.null(res)) {
        for (col in colnames(res)) {
          v <- if (col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) obj@meta.data[[col]] else rep(NA_real_, ncol(obj))
          names(v) <- colnames(obj); v[rownames(res)] <- res[[col]]
          obj[[col]] <- v
        }
        assign(obj_name, obj)
      }
    }
    rm(loom); invisible(gc())
  }
  if ("rna_latent_time" %in% colnames(rna@meta.data)) {
    p <- ggplot(rna@meta.data, aes(timepoint, rna_latent_time, fill = cell_line)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8)) + theme_classic() +
      labs(y = "Latent time (within line)")
    ggsave(file.path(vel_plot_dir, "latent_time_by_line_timepoint.pdf"), p, width = 6, height = 4)
    p
  }
}
```

# 9. Copy-number inference (inferCNV)
ASC cells are the normal (diploid) reference, and LS1 cells are compared with them.
Expression is averaged over about 100 neighbouring genes, so only large CNVs
(roughly arm-level, or focal amplicons of several Mb) are detected.
Uses: confirm LS1's expected CNVs, find LS1 subclones, and test whether a
subclone differentiates differently.
Requires `BiocManager::install("infercnv")`. The HMM step also needs JAGS
installed on the system. Runtime is about 30–90 min.

```{r infercnv, fig.height = 5}
run_infercnv       <- TRUE
cnv_reference_line <- "ASC"
max_cells_per_sample <- 600      # downsampling keeps the runtime reasonable
# Region to score separately: 12q13-15 (MDM2/CDK4/HMGA2), amplified in WD/DD
# liposarcoma. Change it if LS1 is a different tumour type.
roi <- list(name = "chr12q13-15", chr = "chr12", start = 57e6, end = 110e6)

if (run_infercnv && requireNamespace("infercnv", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cnv_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "infercnv")
  dir.create(cnv_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Gene positions (hg38, protein-coding)
  g <- ensembldb::genes(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86::EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86,
                        filter = AnnotationFilter::GeneBiotypeFilter("protein_coding"))
  chr_levels <- paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X"))
  gpos <- data.frame(gene  = g$gene_name,
                     chr   = paste0("chr", as.character(GenomicRanges::seqnames(g))),
                     start = BiocGenerics::start(g), end = BiocGenerics::end(g))
  gpos <- gpos[gpos$chr %in% chr_levels & gpos$gene %in% rownames(rna) & !duplicated(gpos$gene), ]
  gpos <- gpos[order(factor(gpos$chr, levels = chr_levels), gpos$start), ]
  gene_order_file <- file.path(cnv_dir, "gene_order.txt")
  write.table(gpos, gene_order_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

  # Cells (downsampled per sample) and their groups
  cells <- unlist(lapply(split(colnames(rna), rna@meta.data$sample), function(x)
    if (length(x) > max_cells_per_sample) sample(x, max_cells_per_sample) else x), use.names = FALSE)
  ann <- data.frame(cell = cells, group = as.character(rna@meta.data[cells, "sample"]))
  ann_file <- file.path(cnv_dir, "annotations.txt")
  write.table(ann, ann_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

  icnv <- infercnv::CreateInfercnvObject(
    raw_counts_matrix = GetAssayData(rna, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[gpos$gene, cells],
    annotations_file  = ann_file, delim = "\t",
    gene_order_file   = gene_order_file,
    ref_group_names   = samples$sample[samples$cell_line == cnv_reference_line])
  icnv <- infercnv::run(icnv, cutoff = 0.1, out_dir = cnv_dir,
                        cluster_by_groups = TRUE, analysis_mode = "subclusters",
                        denoise = TRUE, HMM = TRUE, HMM_type = "i6",
                        num_threads = 4, no_prelim_plot = TRUE, plot_steps = FALSE)
  # Main heatmap: infercnv/infercnv.png (reference on top, LS1 subclones below)

  # Per-cell scores (residual expression: 1 = neutral, >1 gain, <1 loss)
  expr <- icnv@expr.data
  cnv_score <- colMeans((expr - 1)^2)
  roi_genes <- intersect(gpos$gene[gpos$chr == roi$chr & gpos$start > roi$start & gpos$end < roi$end],
                         rownames(expr))
  roi_score <- colMeans(expr[roi_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  for (nm in c("cnv_score", "cnv_roi_score")) {
    v <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, ncol(rna)), colnames(rna))
    v[colnames(expr)] <- if (nm == "cnv_score") cnv_score else roi_score
    rna[[nm]] <- v
  }
  cnv_df <- rna@meta.data[!is.na(rna$cnv_score), ]

  p1 <- ggplot(cnv_df, aes(sample, cnv_score, fill = cell_line)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA) +
    theme_classic() + RotatedAxis() + labs(x = NULL, y = "CNV score")
  p2 <- ggplot(cnv_df, aes(sample, cnv_roi_score, fill = cell_line)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width") + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_classic() + RotatedAxis() + labs(x = NULL, y = paste(roi$name, "(>1 = gain)"))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "09_cnv_scores_by_sample.pdf"), p1 + p2, width = 12, height = 4.5)
  p1 + p2

  p <- FeaturePlot(rna, c("cnv_score", "cnv_roi_score"), order = TRUE, ncol = 2)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "09_cnv_scores_UMAP.pdf"), p, width = 12, height = 5)
  p

  # Mean residual per chromosome and sample (quick karyotype overview)
  chr_of <- setNames(gpos$chr, gpos$gene)[rownames(expr)]
  smp_of <- rna@meta.data[colnames(expr), "sample"]
  chr_tab <- sapply(split(seq_len(ncol(expr)), smp_of), function(ci)
    tapply(rowMeans(expr[, ci, drop = FALSE]), chr_of, mean))
  chr_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(chr_tab)); colnames(chr_df) <- c("chr", "sample", "mean_residual")
  chr_df$chr <- factor(chr_df$chr, levels = chr_levels)
  write.csv(chr_tab, file.path(cnv_dir, "mean_residual_by_chr_sample.csv"))
  p <- ggplot(chr_df, aes(chr, sample, fill = mean_residual)) + geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 1) +
    theme_minimal() + RotatedAxis() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "09_cnv_by_chromosome.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 3.5)
  p

  # 10 Mb bin profile per sample (log2 ratio) - compared with the ATAC CNV
  # profile in the integration Rmd; the bin size must match the ATAC Rmd
  cnv_bin_size <- 1e7
  gp <- gpos[match(rownames(expr), gpos$gene), ]
  bin_key <- paste(gp$chr, floor((gp$start - 1) / cnv_bin_size) * cnv_bin_size + 1, sep = ":")
  cnv_bins_rna <- bind_rows(lapply(split(seq_len(ncol(expr)), smp_of), function(ci) {
    b <- tapply(rowMeans(expr[, ci, drop = FALSE]), bin_key, mean)
    data.frame(key = names(b), value = log2(as.numeric(b)))
  }), .id = "sample") %>%
    tidyr::separate(key, c("chr", "bin_start"), sep = ":", convert = TRUE)
  write.csv(cnv_bins_rna, file.path(cnv_dir, "cnv_bins_rna.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  # Do LS1 cells with stronger CNV signal differentiate differently?
  ls1 <- cnv_df[cnv_df$cell_line != cnv_reference_line, ]
  if ("rna_pseudotime" %in% colnames(ls1)) {
    ls1$cnv_group <- ifelse(ls1$cnv_roi_score > median(ls1$cnv_roi_score), "high ROI", "low ROI")
    p <- ggplot(ls1, aes(timepoint, rna_pseudotime, fill = cnv_group)) +
      geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8)) + theme_classic()
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "09_pseudotime_by_cnv_group.pdf"), p, width = 6, height = 4)
    p
  }
} else if (run_infercnv) {
  message("inferCNV skipped: install infercnv and EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86")
}
```
